title: Respect container-level p for OneOf and Sequential Albumentations configs
body:
`_build_albu_transform` was forcing `p=1.0` for `OneOf` and `Sequential`, ignoring any container-level probability supplied in `aug_config`.

Changes:
- `OneOf` and `Sequential` now preserve an explicit `p` and default to `1.0` only when omitted.
- Updated the docstring for `_build_albu_transform` to reflect standard Albumentations semantics.
- Updated `docs/learn/train/augmentations.md`.
- Replaced tests that asserted `p` is ignored with coverage for both explicit and default behavior.

Example config that now works as expected:

```yaml
OneOf:
  p: 0.5
  transforms:
    - HorizontalFlip:
        p: 0.6
    - VerticalFlip:
        p: 0.4
```

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #1484
